name: mark_amplifies_teammate_and_credits_help
description: The Lookout's Owl's Eye marks the creep with the most health in reach and every teammate's hit on it lands 20% harder: the Lamplighter's 8-damage arrow does 9.6 to a marked Gourdling. Help (design 3.2): each such hit's damage is the Lookout's Help, once per hit; the Lamplighter's Frost Spire earns her Help on the Lookout's hits on the creeps it slowed; nobody earns Help from their own effects.

steps.assert: t[2].marked == PackedInt32Array([big]) and scene.creep(big).mark_pm == 200 and scene.creep(big).mark_seat == 2 and scene.creep(small).mark_pm == 0
steps.msg: the Owl's Eye marks the Thornback, the creep with the most health in reach, and only it
with the Thornback gone from reach, the Eye marks the Gourdling (one STATUS as the mark takes hold)

steps.assert: help[1] > 0 and help[1] == help[3] and scene.events_where('HELP', {'seat': 2, 'by': 1, 'effect': 3}).size() == scene.amplified_hits(1)
steps.msg: every hit of hers on a marked creep is the Lookout's Help, in full, once

steps.assert: help[0] > 0 and help[0] == help[2] and scene.events_where('HELP', {'seat': 1, 'by': 2, 'effect': 1}).size() > 0
steps.msg: the Lookout's hawk hits on the creep her Frost Spire slowed are the Lamplighter's Help
nobody earns Help from their own effects
classic credits no Help, so its M1 state is unchanged
